channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Trump Opens Door to Hyperliquid In 'Unprecedented Move'
item.description: Bloomberg Intelligence's Dushyant Shahrawat joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." President Trump said US regulators are working to bring Hyperliquid, a fast-growing crypto platform, into the country, offering one of the clearest signals yet that the White House wants to pull a major piece of the industry’s offshore market infrastructure onshore. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Grayscale Launched First Zcash ETF, Token Soars
item.description: Krista Lynch, head of trading and capital markets at Grayscale, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Zcash surged over the past week as Grayscale successfully launched a new ETF that tracks spot exposure to the digital token. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: 'Still Choppy Markets' Ahead For Crypto: Ayesha Kiani
item.description: Ayesha Kiani, COO of Monarq Asset Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the recent rise in the crypto market and Kiani's belief that the market will be "choppy" in the near future. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Earnings, Apple’s AI Macs and OpenAI’s Chip Push | Bloomberg Tech 8/25/2026
item.description: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down what to expect from Nvidia's earnings report on Wednesday, as the stock is on track to snap its seven-session losing streak. Plus, Apple announces new Mac mini and Mac Studio desktop computers with major processor upgrades, and OpenAI says its new Jalapeno chips performed better than Nvidia's current lineup. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Securing AI as OpenAI, Anthropic Models Advance
item.description: AI safety startup Alice has raised $140 million to expand its work stress-testing advanced models and helping companies protect against emerging risks. CEO Noam Schwartz explains how threats once carried out by individuals are increasingly amplified by AI, why recent incidents involving frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic have sharpened attention on the issue, and how the company works with AI labs and enterprises to identify vulnerabilities before they can cause real-world harm. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Gatik Raises $200 Million to Scale Driverless Trucks
item.description: Autonomous trucking startup Gatik has raised $200 million in its largest funding round yet as it moves from developing its technology to scaling commercial operations. CEO and co-founder Gautam Narang joins Bloomberg to discuss plans to deploy hundreds of driverless trucks by year-end, and why North America remains its priority despite growing international interest. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Apple Upgrades Macs for the AI Era
item.description: Apple is upgrading its Mac mini and Mac Studio as demand grows for desktop computers capable of running AI applications locally. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman breaks it all down and explains why memory and silicon shortages are contributing to higher prices. He also discusses Oura’s plans to raise as much as $3 billion in an IPO that could value the smart-ring maker at more than $16 billion. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: What Nvidia Needs to Prove to Investors
item.description: Nvidia is expected to deliver another quarter of extraordinary growth, but Franklin Templeton Portfolio Manager Sara Araghi says the numbers alone may not be enough to change investor sentiment. She discusses why Nvidia needs to provide more clarity on its growing investments across the AI ecosystem, and concerns around “circular financing.” She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bitcoin $80k, 'HYPE' Grows | Bloomberg Crypto 8/25/2026
item.description: "Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Ayesha Kiani, Monarq Asset Management COO, Krista Lynch, Grayscale Head of Trading & Capital Markets, and Ryan Rasmussen, Bitwise Asset Management Director, Head of Research. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Stocks Bounce Before Nvidia as Bessent Faces Pushback | Open Interest 8/25/2026
item.description: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Nvidia tries to snap its losing streak ahead of earnings, while software stocks face a gut check. Scott Bessent faces pushback from his former mentor as Stan Druckenmiller calls Treasury's bond buying a mistake. Meanwhile, Bessent's Iran strategy risks putting Washington on a collision course with Beijing. Plus, Bob Doll, Crossmark Global Investments Chief Investment Officer, and Marija Veitmane, State Street Global Markets Head of Equity Research, on the market outlook ahead of Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI Says New Jalapeno Chips Outperformed Nvidia in Testing
item.description: OpenAI says the new Jalapeno chips performed better than Nvidia Corp.’s current lineup during testing, leading in two categories: the amount of AI work it could handle per unit of power and its speed at returning responses. OpenAI chip chief Richard Ho goes over the results with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Firms Debate Putting Cyber Tests Online After Model Hacks
item.description: Artificial intelligence labs and cybersecurity firms are reconsidering the way they test advanced AI models after models from at least three firms jumped onto the open internet and breached real-world victims.
item.dc:creator: Jordan Robertson and Rachel Metz

item.title: Ex-Googlers Are Planning AI-Human Hybrid to Prevent Rogue Models
item.description: A new nonprofit founded by former Google researchers wants to keep humans at the center of AI development to ensure that the powerful technology is safe and less likely to escape its creators.
item.dc:creator: Julia Love and Davey Alba

item.title: Ex-Meta Staffer Says 99% of Teens Shunned Early Safety Tool
item.description: A former data scientist at Meta Platforms Inc. testified that less than 1% of teenagers were early adopters of a feature designed to get them to take a break from scrolling on Instagram.
item.dc:creator: Madlin Mekelburg

item.title: United Expands Long-Haul Network With 10 International Cities Routes
item.description: United Airlines Holdings Inc. will add destinations in Europe and Asia to its network next year, using Airbus SE's new long-range narrow-body planes. The carrier will fly the A321XLR planes from its Newark hub to locations including Luxembourg and Marseille, and from San Francisco to Okinawa, Japan. Bloomberg's Siddharth Philip joins to discus. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Firms Debate Putting Cyber Tests Online After Model Hacks
item.description: Proponents say that keeping cyber tests connected to the internet improves accuracy.
item.dc:creator: Jordan Robertson and Rachel Metz

item.title: Prosus Investors Push Back on Share Structure and Executive Pay
item.description: Some of the world’s biggest investors have signaled that they object to the share structure of Prosus NV and its parent company Naspers Ltd. and how the companies pay their executives and board members.
item.dc:creator: Antony Sguazzin, Loni Prinsloo and Bradley August

item.title: Apple Mac Mini Revamp; Dick's Sporting Goods Falls on Outlook | Stock Movers
item.description:
On this episode of Stock Movers:
- Dick's Sporting Goods (DKS) shares are plummeting as it lowered its full-year outlook amid weakness at its recently acquired Foot Locker unit. - Apple (AAPL) shares are slightly lower as the tech giant is gearing up to launch a new version of its Mac mini desktop computer for the first time in almost two years, according to people familiar with the matter. - SpaceX (SPCX) shares are higher in the premarket as Elon Musk says SpaceX's first AI satellites, powered by Nvidia chips, will initially launch in the fourth quarter of next year and hit "significant scale" in 2028. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI Claims Its New Chips Can Outperform Nvidia Processors in Tests
item.description: Jalapeno chip will let OpenAI customers choose models that offer lower cost or faster answers
item.dc:creator: Dina Bass

item.title: US Stocks Pare Gains as Traders Weigh Consumer Confidence Data
item.description: US stocks pared gains on Tuesday as investors pored over the latest read on consumer confidence while preparing for Nvidia Corp. earnings and the Jackson Hole Symposium later this week.
item.dc:creator: Joel Leon
